messages:
Mia: AM check-in — quick async on content calendar + launch benchmarks. What I shipped: updated landing hero copy and CTA variants.

Mia: Blocker: need analytics sign-off on the benchmark numbers before we push paid.

Jasper: Ran a smoke bench on staging overnight, disabled an inefficient op in the batcher. Observed stable throughput.

Jasper: Waiting on the marketing prompt sample to finalize the batching groups. @Mia can you drop it here?

Ava: Thumbnails v3 uploaded to Figma (file pinned). Minor spacing fix needed pending brand palette finalization. @Mia :art: 

Ravi: Ads & tracking done. Question: should UTMs use `bench_launch_v2` or `bench_launch_final`? I prefer `bench_launch_final`.

Mia: Use `bench_launch_final` for campaign parity. Example UTM: 
```
https://redwood.example/launch?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch_final
```

Jasper: PR up for the ingestion tool — PR #3245: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3245. CI green, added changelog entry about the batcher memory fix.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> 2024-08-01 09:00 UTC. All checks passing.

Luca: Analytics note: preliminary run shows model-x latency +0.28s on long-tail prompts, but tokens/sec improved ~12% for mid-length. I'll export per-prompt CSV to the benchmarks doc.

Mia: Good — add exact numbers + sample prompts to the public benchmarks doc (linked in the calendar event). @Jasper please add a short note in the PR about the latency tradeoff so we can craft messaging defensibly.

Jasper: Will add a bullet in PR body and freeze model topology changes until 11:00 PST to avoid noisy regressions during launch window.

Mia: Roll-forward plan: if latency regresses >10% on main after merge, notify #eng-oncall, pause the paid campaign, and roll to previous model variant.

Ava: Uploading final thumbnails to /assets/launch/benchmarks/ now. Sending alt-copy in thread.

Ravi: Paid posts scheduled for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. I'll monitor attribution and post a short status after 1 hour.

Mia: Quick action items: 1) @Ava — alt copy for thumbnails, 2) @Luca — attach CSV of per-prompt latencies to the benchmarks doc, 3) @Jasper — confirm exact merge window and ping here when merged.

Jasper: Ack — aiming to merge after the staging smoke at 09:30 UTC, will ping when merged. :thumbsup:

Mia: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop the snippet here and Ill triage. :rocket:
